transcript: I've been to every country in the world and here are three times I really thought I was gonna die. Number one is an allergic reaction in a rural island in the Philippines. I went fishing with some local people on the island. I came out, my whole body had this crazy red rash. My lips and my feet were numb and thankfully the reaction didn't get in my throat or else I would have had a few minutes left to live. And by the way, I still don't know what got me in the ocean. Number two was surviving that massive earthquake in Nepal in 2015. I was actually in Delhi on the runway to head to Kathmandu. I was on the plane when the earthquake hit And I just feel so bad for all the lives that were lost. and the devastation that it caused in Kathmandu and beyond. And number three was in the catacombs in Paris, the underground labyrinth of tunnels that is 200 miles long. It was me and my YouTube friend, Sam and Colby, and we just had a local guide. You're trapped underground with no GPS, no signal, and really no food. So thankfully, we got out safely.
metadata_caption: 3 Scariest Travel Days Of My Life
